data.name: Monster Collector
data.detailed_description:
Monster Collector is a single-player collection RPG focused on discovery and collecting.

Across 20 distinct regions, you'll encounter 1,020 monsters, including standard monsters, color variants, rare monsters, and ultra-rare creatures.

Battle them, record your discoveries, recruit them to your party, and keep searching for the ones you haven't found yet.

Rather than focusing only on becoming stronger, Monster Collector is about the satisfaction of discovering, collecting, and completing your catalogs.

Collect 1,020 Monsters

Travel through 20 distinct regions, including grasslands, forests, rivers, snowy fields, volcanoes, the deep sea, and otherworldly realms.

Your encounters, victories, recruits, drops, and other discoveries are recorded in the Monster Catalog. Search for monsters you haven't encountered yet, hunt down rare variants, and gradually work toward completing your collection.

Plan Your Next Hunt

There are many things to collect, including standard materials, rare materials, emblems, color variants, and recruitable monsters.

Choose the regions and equipment that best suit your goal, decide what you want to collect next, and plan your runs accordingly.

Recruit and Raise Your Monsters

Build a party of up to four monsters from the creatures you've recruited.

Manage your collection at the Ranch, where you can sort, search, and compare stats to find your favorites among the many monsters you've collected.

Complete Five Catalogs

Monsters aren't the only things to collect.

  • Monster Catalog

  • Item Catalog

  • Emblem Catalog

  • Accessory Catalog

  • Furniture Catalog

Discover collections scattered throughout the world and aim for 100% completion.

Reliable Save System for Long-Term Collecting

Monster Collector supports autosaving, three manual save slots, checksums, three generations of backups, and automatic recovery from corrupted save data. A dedicated save file for Steam Auto-Cloud is also included.

Main Features

  • Single-player

  • English and Japanese

  • Keyboard and mouse controls

  • Fullscreen display

data.short_description: Collect over 1,000 monsters, including rare variants and ultra-rare creatures. Explore 20 regions, complete every collection, and become the ultimate collector in this collection-focused monster RPG.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
